tools.name: webcap_service_catalog
tools.description: Free service catalog (no payment): every paid endpoint with its exact price in USDC, the settlement network, USDC asset, payTo address, facilitator and the step-by-step x402 how-to-pay flow, plus the free allowance this caller has left. Call this first to learn what webcap sells and what it costs.

tools.name: webcap_preview
tools.description: Free bounded preview of a page: title, description, headings, links, word count and a truncated markdown slice. Use it to peek before the full extract. Rate-limited per IP. This is a teaser, not the product: the real products are free too inside the rolling per-IP allowance.

tools.name: webcap_og
tools.description: Free Open Graph metadata for a URL: title, description, image, icon. No payment.

tools.name: webcap_capture
tools.description: PAID ($0.001 image/PDF, $0.005 video): turn a URL into a persistent public artifact. png/jpeg/pdf are a screenshot or PDF and include free OG metadata; mp4/webm scroll-record the page as WebM/VP8 (mp4 is a legacy alias). Settles gasless USDC over x402 — but an unpaid call runs free while the rolling

tools.name: webcap_extract
tools.description: PAID ($0.01, one payment covers a batch of up to 50 URLs): structured content as JSON — title, headings, paragraphs, links, images, document-order markdown. Provide exactly one of "url" (a single page) or "urls" (a batch); "url" is shorthand for a one-item "urls".

tools.name: webcap_audit
tools.description: PAID ($0.002): SEO basics plus link and Open Graph health for one URL in a single call. Returns issues with severity, not just raw tags.

tools.name: webcap_map_lite
tools.description: PAID ($0.002): discover a site's URLs from its sitemap and robots.txt plus a 1-hop same-host crawl, and return them as a JSON list. Cheaper than crawling each page with webcap_extract.

tools.name: webcap_analyze
tools.description: PAID ($0.01): AI analysis of one URL. Pick the task that matches the question you are answering.
